title: Dry Skin Around the Nose: Causes and Gentle Care in Winter and Colds
ex: Why the skin around your nose flakes during colds and Indian winters, what to put on it, what to avoid and when to see a doctor.
rt: Dry Skin Around Nose: Causes and Gentle Care | Mirc Glow
rd: Dry skin around the nose from a cold, winter air or harsh washing? Simple steps, what to apply and avoid on flaky nostril skin, and when to see a doctor.
quick: Dry skin around the nose usually comes from nose-blowing during a cold, dry winter air and hot water or soap. Blow and dab gently with soft tissue, rinse with plain lukewarm water, and keep a thin barrier of petroleum jelly or a plain moisturiser on the area.
facts: Rubbing with rough tissues roughens nostril skin
Skip actives and scrubs on flaky skin
Greasy recurring flakes need a dermatologist
